title: karni build --json
description: Experimental. The output of karni build --json.

_FileOut.description: One file a build writes (or, with --dry-run, would write).

path.description: The file, relative to the project root.

owner.description: karni: a Karni-owned file or block, rewritten on every build. project: a file of the project's, created once or given a missing class.

_HandEditOut.description: A Karni-owned file or block edited by hand: the build stops before it writes anything.

path.description: The file, or the block (config/settings.py, routes.tsx ...).

lines.description: The lines of the file on disk that differ (1-based).

diff.description: A short diff: - what karni build writes, + the file.

unrecorded.description: true: the file exists but karni build never wrote it (not in the record).

name.description: The step: modules, files, migrations, migrate, seed, types, test, check.

status.description: done, skipped (nothing to do), failed (the build stopped here) or pending (not reached: the next karni build runs it).

summary.description: One line: what the step did, or why it failed.

valid.description: false when the spec has problems: then issues lists them.

issues.description: The spec's problems, as karni spec validate --json reports them.

status.description: How the build ended: built, nothing to build, dry run, refused, failed, invalid.

code.description: The error code when refused or failed (karni explain <code>). null otherwise.

message.description: What stopped the build. null when nothing did.

plan.description: The plan, exactly as karni plan --json prints it (docs/assets/karni-plan.schema.json). null when the spec has problems.

hand_edits.description: Karni-owned files and blocks edited by hand. The build stops on them (C273) unless --force (a .orig backup is kept) or --adopt.

adopted.description: Karni-owned files and blocks the project adopted: karni build leaves them.

steps.description: Every step, in order, with how it went.

next.description: What to do next, when something is left to do.
